vE8YNVgM.summary: Confirmed swing pivots define sloped support and resistance. A qualifying price cross after an uninterrupted interval is the signal; the pivot's drawing date is not the signal availability date.
vE8YNVgM.requirements: The author supplies no complete stop/target lifecycle. Inputs choose close or wick and whether earlier line breaks invalidate it. A shorter pivot length or added break filter is a distinct strategy, not a reader correction.

IV6eZF3w.summary: A confirmed structural break or change of character produces a directional breakout setup with volatility-derived targets. Close-versus-wick confirmation is configurable.
IV6eZF3w.requirements: Displayed target-hit statistics are the indicator's internal model, not exchange profitability. Preserve the existing tested long-side allow-list; a two-sided author reading needs separate evidence and native level extraction.

K0dz3kws.summary: Ranked swings establish a volume-weighted trend leg. The author uses aligned polarity, pullbacks and qualified retests for decisions; plain price crosses also provide context.
K0dz3kws.requirements: Reconstructed VWAP starts at a past pivot but becomes usable only when the new anchor is accepted. The author provides no complete position lifecycle. Current cross entries are a bot interpretation and must not be silently replaced.

VrTL3VwF.summary: An RSI analogue classifier combines rank and confidence with trend, volatility and chop filters. The classifier's Long/Short outputs are distinct from SuperTrend regime flips.
VrTL3VwF.requirements: Keep ST Flip Up and ST Flip Dn out of the classifier-only comparison. Scores are not calibrated win probabilities. Future-horizon training labels must be mature before use; source implementation, not the author's no-repaint claim alone, determines causality.

r8j7m88J.summary: Five weighted SuperTrend members must meet the consensus threshold and agree with the selected base member before the cluster regime changes.
r8j7m88J.requirements: Base ST Long/Short mark only one member's flip. Use Major Long/Short or their matching Long/Short conditions for the consensus variant. The cluster line is a guide, not a complete author stop/target plan.

d3IaFa7c.summary: ATR-based discrete trend steps define a volatility channel. The author's upper retest is a bearish resistance test; the lower retest is a bullish support test.
d3IaFa7c.requirements: Decision 195 intentionally trades the opposite interpretation as continuation. Keep it distinct from the existing native retest variant. Step markers describe trend state; the author does not prescribe a full trade lifecycle.

pIdVZEJY.summary: Heikin-Ashi SuperTrend changes arm a buffered breakout; price confirmation and the buffered trailing line govern the trade.
pIdVZEJY.requirements: Synthetic Heikin-Ashi prices must never become executable Delta fills. Reconcile the Pine strategy ledger, pending stop/limit orders and confirmation timing before calling a signal-plus-bot-stop reading author-native. Retain bot capital and risk controls.

XuywwObg.summary: Long-only oversold RSI plus exceptional volume permits up to three ladder entries, each requiring a further price drop. The target follows average entry and the stop follows the lowest fill, with separate exit cooldowns.
XuywwObg.requirements: The bot currently ignores additional same-direction entries, so it does not reproduce this basket. A native adapter needs fill-based basket state, aggregate margin/risk checks, OCO updates and cooldown parity. The historical source-study verdict is not engine validation. Do not import the author's equity sizing or claim its candle fills as exchange fills.

wMcOiPoG.summary: Extreme estimated delta, a stalled body, swing extreme and rejection wick arm an absorption reversal. The default waits up to three bars for a confirming close; violating the extreme cancels it.
wMcOiPoG.requirements: The source spacing OR can bypass the required absorption test. Keep the existing quarantine until the expression and lower-timeframe data coverage are validated. Delta is a candle proxy, not exchange aggressor flow; source position sizing and costs are placeholders.

oM444F7G.summary: SMA/ATR trend bands and aligned fair-value gaps guide discretionary pullback analysis. The author suggests rejection at unmitigated gaps, but the code does not emit a complete rejection-entry condition.
oM444F7G.requirements: Do not trade the bullish/bearish statistics label or gap creation as a confirmed entry. Volume boxes estimate candle-position shares. A causal rejection rule and explicit protection would be a new, separately evaluated strategy.
